entities.summary: Noah Hawley is an American filmmaker, author, and singer. He is best known for creating, chiefly writing and often directing the FX television series Fargo (2014–2024), Legion (2017–2019) and Alien: Earth (2025–present). He also worked on the series Bones (2005–2008), The Unusuals (2009), and My Generation (2010).
